newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka June avg annual inflation at 14.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka June avg annual inflation at 14.7 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's annual average inflation rate fell to 14.7 percent in June against 15.8 in the previous month, the Census and Statistics Department said on Tuesday.
The Colombo Consumer Price Index (CCPI) for June rose 10.6 points to 2,058 from 2,047.4 in May, the department said in a statement.
It said the increase in the index was mainly due to rises in the prices of bread, fish and some vegetables.
But prices of rice, tea, dried chillies, potatoes, coconuts, coconut oil, eggs and some varities of dried fish showed a decline.

The Central Bank governor Amarananda Jayawardena told Reuters in an interview last week that inflation was likely to fall to between eight and nine percent by the year-end, against 15.9 percent in 1996.
